current_behaviour: Group 'Forecasting' with four sub-items: Viewer, Accuracy, Forecast, TTL. TTL is marked planned. Active state is a CSS class toggled by custom.js on data-section.
ux_pattern: Collapsible grouped nav with active highlight
notes: V6.24 already added its own group the same way; no change needed

current_behaviour: Title, one-paragraph purpose, then a collapsed 'How to use this viewer' list whose counts are derived from the contract, never hardcoded.
ux_pattern: Progressive help that does not shout
notes: V6.24 Overview has no equivalent collapse; its help text is always visible

current_behaviour: Two-column navigator: a left rail of progressive fields and a right route panel with breadcrumb, route state and route metadata cards. A blue pill shows 'N Viewer-complete cases / M routes'.
ux_pattern: Guided progressive disclosure with live context
notes: THE reference for P9C. Cannot be reused as-is: bound to the V6.18 schema

current_behaviour: Axes are resolved per branch. HDD: demand_nature -> db_type -> (segment only when EDB) -> granularity -> entity or forest+sku. SSD: db_type -> (stop when MCDB) -> prepared_scenario -> granularity -> entity. An axis with no remaining choices is simply not rendered.
ux_pattern: Only show what applies to this branch
notes: V6.24 renders all six axes always, using NOT_APPLICABLE as a value

current_behaviour: Chips showing the path being built (HDD > Organic > EDB > Consumer > Forest > APCP153). Shows 'Select a Metric' when empty.
ux_pattern: Live path feedback
notes: V6.24 has only a one-line green text, no chips

current_behaviour: OPERATIONAL badge with 'Prepared route and entity are available', then a six-cell card grid: ROUTE, DISPLAY LABEL, ENTITY TYPE, SERVING STATUS, SUPPORT, ACTUALS, plus a traceability note.
ux_pattern: Resolve the selection back to source fields
notes: V6.24 has a flat key/value list instead of cards

current_behaviour: A teal pill 'Forecast-only, not selectable here' plus an explanation that N prepared cases have forward forecasts but no actuals and no backtests, so nothing was fabricated.
ux_pattern: Explain absence instead of hiding it
notes: V6.24 has no forecast-only population: all 140 series carry both

current_behaviour: Kicker B, title, slate pill '15 verified models', an availability banner, horizon radios, disabled horizon chips, history window select, live model count, family-grouped checkboxes, Analyze and Reset.
ux_pattern: Configure then commit
notes: THE reference for P9D

current_behaviour: radioButtons over 5/10/15/20/25/30 days. 35 and 45 render as struck-through disabled chips labelled 'Prepared artifact covers 1-30 day horizons.'
ux_pattern: Show the limit instead of hiding it
notes: V6.24 backtests carry horizon_steps 1..30, so this transfers directly

current_behaviour: Four checkbox columns: Growth Baseline, Statistical, Machine Learning, Deep Learning. Order fixed by FVP_FAMILY_ORDER; labels by FVP_FAMILY_LABELS.
ux_pattern: Group by family, not one long list
notes: V6.24 model_family has only 3 values (Baseline/Challenger/Neural); the 4-family split must come from the legacy artifact or an explicit map

current_behaviour: fvp_model_label() appends ' ★ champion' to the checkbox label when is_selected_champion is TRUE. High-risk badges are deliberately not shown.
ux_pattern: One badge, not a wall of badges
notes: V6.24 must gate the star on champion_visible so no-signal series show none

current_behaviour: The chart is an eventReactive on the Analyze click, not on control change. Reset restores default models and horizon.
ux_pattern: Explicit commit for an expensive render
notes: V6.24 re-renders on every dropdown change

current_behaviour: highchartOutput at 600px: one Actual line plus one line per selected model, title 'Backtest Comparison', subtitle 'series - horizon N days - M models - date range', datetime x-axis with crosshair, interactive legend, export menu, per-series tooltips carrying family and risk.
ux_pattern: One rich, interactive chart
notes: THE reference for P9E. Only the data accessors change

current_behaviour: Read-only counts describing what the chart used.
ux_pattern: Evidence under the chart
notes: V6.24 has no notes panel

current_behaviour: uiOutput('fvp_download_ui') under the chart, backed by row-level export of the current selection.
ux_pattern: Export what you are looking at
notes: V6.24 has no download at all

current_behaviour: llm_explain_ui('llm_forecast_viewer', 'Forecast Viewer') closes the section.
ux_pattern: Assistant closes the page, does not introduce it
notes: Evidence is page-keyed, not selection-aware; see the assistant study

current_behaviour: Same two-card pattern as Viewer, sharing the taxonomy module on page 'forecast'. Adds a history control and its own Analyze/Reset.
ux_pattern: Consistent with Viewer
notes: Shows the taxonomy module is already page-parameterised

current_behaviour: highchartOutput at 560px with a custom legend above it; actual history plus forward forecast with a boundary marker.
ux_pattern: History and future in one chart
notes: THE reference for P9F

current_behaviour: acc_compute() filters prepared accuracy, acc_heatmap() renders a model x series heatmap, acc_table() the detail.
ux_pattern: Matrix view of model quality
notes: Useful later for a V6.24 accuracy page; not in the P9C-P9G scope

current_behaviour: ttl_gauge(), ttl_line_chart(), ttl_heatmap() over a snapshot artifact.
ux_pattern: Capacity view
notes: No V6.24 equivalent and no governed TTL artifact; out of scope

current_behaviour: highcharter everywhere: fv_chart, fvp_chart, fvf_chart, acc_heatmap, ttl_* all build highchart objects.
ux_pattern: One chart language
notes: highcharter is already a declared dependency; adding it costs nothing

current_behaviour: outputOptions(output, id, suspendWhenHidden = FALSE) is used where a section starts hidden.
ux_pattern: Defensive against CSS-toggled sections
notes: The pattern P8 had to rediscover through a browser defect
